structure.description: Insurance joins use company_id across dimensions, policies, and performance; policy_id links claims; customer IDs identify policyholder/insured; agent_id links sales and monthly performance.
Company statements join dim_company on company_id and share period_date, period_type, report_type, and currency; documented amount fields are CNY.
Fund tables join on fund_code; holdings also use sec_code or industry_code, and invest_advisor_code links products to advisors.

uncertainties: SQLite date and timestamp fields are text/date-like values and should be parsed explicitly before date arithmetic.
Ratios and returns may be stored as fractions or percentage-style numbers; verify observed magnitude and the supplied documentation before rescaling.
Nullable fields are common, especially optional lifecycle dates, listing data, claim outcomes, portfolio values, and long-horizon fund returns.
annotation_notes: Exact SQLite column names are listed separately.
Public Markdown files provide fuller Chinese business definitions for ambiguous terms.
